title: Recent advancements in solid-state batteries
description: Search for and summarize the most significant breakthroughs in solid-state battery technology from the last 2 years.
rubric: Must correctly call the web_search or paper_search tool.
Must cite at least 2 distinct sources.
Output summary must mention solid-state technology specifically.

title: Compare Rust and Go for web backends
description: Analyze the tradeoffs between Rust and Go for building high-concurrency web APIs.
rubric: Must mention memory safety (Rust) and garbage collection (Go).
Must correctly call a search tool.
Must return a structured comparison in the summary.

title: Analyze TSLA stock trends
description: Find recent TSLA stock prices and analyze the trend over the last month.
rubric: Must call a web search or dataset search tool for TSLA data.
Must extract specific numeric prices or percentages.
Must provide a clear trend conclusion (up, down, or flat).

title: Write a python script to parse CSV
description: Write a Python function that takes a CSV string, parses it, and returns a list of dictionaries. Handle missing values by setting them to None.
rubric: Must include a working Python function.
The function must handle missing values as requested.

title: Create a React hook for debouncing
description: Write a custom React hook called useDebounce that takes a value and a delay.
rubric: Must include valid TypeScript/JavaScript code for a React hook.
Must properly clear the timeout on unmount or value change.
